'''Samara Naeymi''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Naeymi became an actress as an adult, but only got minor roles initially. She then started getting more significant roles when she voiced supporting characters in several cartoon series, including English-dubbed versions of international shows. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, most notably voicing [[Kalos Elite Four]] member and secret [[Team Flare]] agent [[Malva]], as well as [[character of the day]] [[Jean]]. Naeymi currently resides in New York City, New York.
